name: Ancestor Domain
body:
Granted Powers: The power of your faith is strong enough to form a bond with the spirit of one of your ancestors. This ancestor guides you, reveals secrets from the realm of spirits, and bestows you with the fearsome strength they once held in the land of the living.

Ancestor’s Guidance (Su)

As a free action, you may channel some of the wisdom and experience of your ancestor, adding an insight bonus equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum +1) to any one skill check you make. You may only use this ability once per skill check.

You may use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Ancestor’s Blessing (Su)

At 6th level, as a swift action, you can beseech your ancestor to infuse you with the power to strike the intangible. This power applies the ghost touch weapon special ability to all of your natural attacks (if any) and to any weapons you wield. Once activated, this power lasts until you dismiss it with a free action. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to your cleric level; these rounds need not be consecutive.

Domain spells: 1st-discern spirit presence or spirit trance; 2nd-ancestral wrath or blade tutor’s spirit; 3rd–speak with dead; 4th–divination; 5th–atonement; 6th-geas/quest; 7th–legend lore; 8th-ancestral might or compulsory conversion; 9th–foresight.

* This spell functions as the glimpse of the akashic spell, except that you are not accessing the Akashic Record but your ancestor’s accumulated experiences and spirit.
